_comment: World rules — a data-driven rule layer for world mechanics. Each rule is a stable key with a small config. Unknown keys are ignored, a malformed rule is disabled with a warning, and a missing or empty file means all rules off (legacy behavior). Shipped rules: damageTornMaterial (torn-material chunk percent), onDamage (event table: probabilistic chunk drop on any weakening). The energyFlow rule was removed from the data (energy redistribution is off by configuration; the controller degrades to a silent no-op without it).
